turnaround_reason: Coty, a fragrance/cosmetics maker (Burberry, Gucci, CoverGirl, Rimmel), fell to ~$2.60 from $4.47 on soft consumer-beauty demand and a heavy debt load; the turnaround is a deleveraging + portfolio-simplification story under the 'Coty.Curated' framework.
bullish_points: Net debt cut ~$840M YoY via the December-2025 Wella monetization and strong FCF ($363M)
July-2026 sale of the Gucci Beauty license back to Kering for $400M (plus inventory) adds cash to pay down debt
Returned to sales growth; forward P/E ~10 and P/B 0.77 are cheap for a global fragrance portfolio
Insider buying: officer/director bought 83k shares at $2.41 and CFO added at $2.65 — cheap-conviction signal near lows
62.9% gross margin gives operating leverage if the fixed-cost reduction program lands
bearish_points: Debt is still the whole story: $3.3B total debt, D/E 98%, current ratio 0.755 (tight liquidity)
GAAP operating margin negative (-2.4%) and profit margin -10%; the 'growth' is barely positive (+1.3%)
FY27 explicitly flagged as a transition year — no clean earnings inflection expected near term
Consumer Beauty strategic review still open; a mass-market divestiture could be dilutive/messy
JAB-controlled float and 12.9% short interest; consumer-beauty demand remains soft
catalyst: Q1 FY27 earnings (deleveraging progress + cost-out traction) and resolution of the Consumer Beauty strategic review
catalyst_timing: Q1 FY27 earnings 2026-11-05; Consumer Beauty review decision by end of CY26
suggested_trade: Spot only, small speculative deep-value tranche; a sub-$3 handle on a deleveraging turnaround with insider buys, but size for the debt risk
key_risk: Consumer-beauty demand stays soft and the tight current ratio forces a dilutive refinancing before earnings recover
would_skip_if: You avoid sub-$3 highly-levered consumer names, or you want the Consumer Beauty review resolved before committing
